name: Javelin
overview: The javelin, described as a heavy lance, appears in Scripture as a weapon of war and personal defense, notably used by figures such as Saul and Goliath. In 1 Samuel 19, Saul, under the influence of an evil spirit, wields his javelin with intent to harm David, illustrating its role as a close-range weapon. Ezekiel 39:9 further highlights the javelin among the weapons to be destroyed in a time of peace, emphasizing its significance in ancient warfare. These passages collectively reveal the javelin's practical use and symbolic representation of conflict in biblical history.
